scope: Role-specific DeepAgents research worker using supported native graph, task-selected skills, specialist delegation and persisted checkpoint continuation. Candidate trial, not default promotion.

sources.installation: Native uv requirements resolution; exact supported create_deep_agent composition, no orchestration loop.

sources.purpose: Native ChatOpenAI explicit child base_url, Responses and max reasoning; resolved integration dependencies differ from upstream DeepAgents lock.
Native SQLite checkpointer; exact source pin will be bound before execution.
Supported native MCP tools only when the bounded task needs them.

roles.coordinator: Retained native Claude/Codex accounts; one integrating coordinator

judge.trigger: Independent consequential judgment if selected; simple task correctness decided by unchanged executable oracle

roles.candidate_role: Persisted multi-step research with task-selected skill and specialist context

baseline.retained: Qualified Codex SDK0.159.2/Dagu workflow; no new comparison rerun
baseline.deepagents: Installed package absence must be captured before install
baseline.upstream_dependency_context: DeepAgents source uv.lock uses langchain-openai1.1.14; current1.6.7 integration must be labelled separately.

acceptance.required: Exact native package metadata and uv pip check, hashed resolved requirements; dependency scan.
Unchanged selected skills/subagent/graph upstream tests, exact file selection/hashes, actual returned results/skips. No mocked output promoted to provider acceptance.
Explicit child OmniRoute20128 Responses/Sol-Max; selected skill directory and tools; bounded native delegation/middleware only if source supports it; private SQLite state.

Only after source/config readiness, freeze task and exact deterministic oracle; one bounded initial worker run and persisted continuation from a separate process. Real skill/tool/specialist invocation independently observed, cancellation/cleanup retained.
Same task oracle fails for absent/wrong output or missing capability; distinguish fixture control from upstream tests.

task_trial.status: not started; exact fixture and oracle will be frozen before any provider call
task_trial.skill_policy: Load one source-pinned relevant skill progressively; native automatic compaction/cache preserved
task_trial.provider_usage: Native whole-run usage when returned; unknown fields remain null. Parent/child and provider/observer counters not added twice.

ownership.implementation: examples/deepagents-omniroute/ only in separate worker worktree; root owns source matrix/receipts/plan
ownership.shared: No O1 sandbox recipe, gateway, shared skill catalog, active untracked landscape or global clients/settings modification.

rollback: Remove only this owned private candidate environment, SQLite state and task fixtures; retain public source/tests and sanitized failures.
